question: Can the physical one-loop four-graviton C5 anchor be imported directly into the finite-soft regular+log extractor, or is a higher-point object required?

scientific_result.reason: for real massless four-point on-shell kinematics, taking one external graviton independently soft degenerates the remaining three-point hard configuration; the 4-point amplitude is a hard nonanalytic anchor, not the required finite-soft multipoint control
scientific_result.viable_pure_Einstein_route: construct the five-point one-loop channel discontinuity directly from two-particle unitarity using physical tree Einstein amplitudes; no full integrated one-loop amplitude is required for the discontinuity
